(106:4) الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ He who has fed their hunger, and made them secure from fear

2 [also possibly v. III] to trust someone

(12:64) قَالَ هَلْ ءَامَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ كَمَا أَمِنْتُكُمْ عَلَى أَخِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ he said, ‘Do I trust you with him other than how I trusted you with his brother before [with the same disastrous result] !?’

entries.label: آمِنٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
آمِنٌ ʾāmin [quasi-act. part.; fem. آمِنَةٌ ʾāminatun; pl. آمِنُون ʾāminūn]

1 safe, secure

(16:112) وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلاً قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةً مُطْمَئِنَّةً God presents the parable of a city that was secure and at ease

2 peaceful, at peace, tranquil

(44:55) يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ peaceful [and contented], they will call for every kind of fruit.

entries.label: أَمَانَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَمَانَةٌ ʾamānatun [fem. n., pl. أَمَانَاتٌ ʾamānāt] trust, charge

(4:58) إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَنْ تُؤَدُّوا الأَمَانَاتِ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا God commands you to return trusts to their owners; *

(33:72) إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الأَمَانَةَ عَلَى السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الإِنْسَانُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولاً We offered the trust to the heavens, the Earth and the mountains, yet they refused to carry it and were afraid of it; but man carried it–indeed he is sinful, ignorant. Commentators greatly differ as to the meaning of الأَمَانَةَ with the definite article in this context. Being charged with responsibility (التكليف), with the definite article, is chosen by ʾal-Rāzī; this choice fits the larger context. Other interpretations include: obedience, the choice between obedience and disobedience as offered to Adam, reason or intellect, prayer and other duties and obligatory statutes which God has imposed upon His servants.

entries.label: أَمَنَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَمَنَةٌ ʾamanatun [n.] inner calm, tranquillity, relaxation, peace

(3:154) ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْغَمِّ أَمَنَةً نُعَاسًا يَغْشَى طَائِفَةً مِنْكُمْ then He caused peace, after sorrow, to descend upon you–a sleep which overtook a group of you.

entries.label: أَمِنَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَمِنَ ʾamina a [v.] I [intrans.] to feel safe, to be in a time of safety

(2:196) فَإِذَا أَمِنْتُمْ فَمَنْ تَمَتَّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ فَمَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ and if you are in time of peace/you feel safe, anyone wishing to break the restrictions of consecration between the minor pilgrimage and the major one must make whatever offering he can afford II [trans.]

1 to trust someone with or over something

(2:283) فَإِنْ أَمِنَ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا فَلْيُؤَدِّ الَّذِي اؤْتُمِنَ أَمَانَتَهُ but if you decide to trust one another [with or over something], then let the one who is trusted deliver his trust

2 to guard against, to wish to be safe from

(4:91) سَتَجِدُونَ ءَاخَرِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَأْمَنُوكُمْ وَيَأْمَنُوا قَوْمَهُمْ you will find others who wish to be safe from you, and from their own people.

entries.label: أَمِينٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَمِينٌ ʾamīn [quasi-act. part.]

1 honest, trustworthy

(26:193) نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الأَمِينُ the trustworthy spirit came down with it

2 sincere, honest

(7:68) أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالاَتِ رَبِّي وَأَنَا لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am a sincere adviser to you

3 safe, secure

(95:3) وَهَذَا الْبَلَدِ الأَمِينِ and [by] this safe town.

entries.label: أَمْنٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَمْنٌ ʾamn [v. n./n.]

1 safety, security

(24:55) وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا and He will give them in exchange, after their fear, security

2 peace, tranquillity, sanctuary

(2:125) وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا and when We made the House [at Mecca] a resort and a sanctuary for people.

entries.label: إِيمَانٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
إِيمَانٌ ʾīmān [v. n./n.]

1 faith

(59:9) وَالَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالإِيمَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ and those who are firmly established in their homes and in the faith before them, love whoever emigrated to them

2 believing, belief

(16:106) مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ he who denies God after having believed

3 (contrasted to ʾislām) deeply entrenched true faith

(49:14) وَلَكِنْ قُولُوا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الإِيمَانُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ but you should say, ‘We have submitted’–as true faith has not yet entered your hearts.

entries.label: اأْتُمِنَ
entries.definitionHtml:
اأْتُمِنَ ʾiʾtumina [pass. of v. VIII ائْتَمَنَ ʾiʾtamana] to be entrusted with

(2:283) فَإِنْ أَمِنَ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا فَلْيُؤَدِّ الَّذِي اؤْتُمِنَ أَمَانَتَهُ but if you decide to trust one another, then let the one who is trusted fulfil his trust.

entries.label: مَأْمَنٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَأْمَنٌ maʾman [n. of place] place of safety, place of security

(9:6) وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ اسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُ and if any one of the polytheists should seek your protection [Prophet], grant it to him so that he may hear the word of God, then take him to his place of safety.

entries.label: مَأْمُون
entries.definitionHtml:
مَأْمُون maʾmūn [pass. part.] something devoid of harm, something completely safe

(70:28) إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ [for] from the chastisement of their Lord none may feel completely safe.

entries.label: مُؤْمِنٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُؤْمِنٌ muʾmin [quasi-act. part./n.; dual مُؤْمِنَيْنِ muʾminayn; pl. مُؤْمِنُون muʾminūn; fem. مُؤْمِنَةٌ muʾminatun; pl. مُؤْمِنَاتٌ muʾmināt]

1 adherent to the true faith

(33:36) وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلاَ مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ it is not fitting for any believing man or a believing woman, once God and His Messenger have decided on a matter, that they should have a choice of their own [in the matter]

2 one who believes

(26:3) لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ أَلاَّ يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ perhaps you [Prophet] are going to torment yourself to death [worrying] that they will not become believers!?
